metadata.title: When you try to clutch but the spray pattern wrote its own drama script
metadata.description:
Ever had your bullets dance to a tune only they hear? This clip is pure “what even is aiming” energy. 
If your spray pattern’s got more mood swings than your ex, you’re in for a treat.

Watch the chaos unfold and try not to cry-laugh!

Click if your bullets ever had a mind of their own!
